name: Standard Tiered Conformance Ruleset
description: Enforces strict 3-tier layering with explicit ALLOW, FORBID, and REQUIRE constraints

rules.name: Allow Controller to Service
rules.description: Controllers may delegate business logic to services

rules.name: Allow Service to Repository
rules.description: Services may interact with repositories for data persistence

rules.name: Allow Repository to Database
rules.description: Repositories may issue queries to databases

rules.name: Forbid Controller to Repository
rules.description: Controllers must NOT bypass the business logic service layer

rules.name: Forbid Controller to Database
rules.description: Controllers must NOT communicate directly with databases

rules.name: Forbid Frontend to Database
rules.description: Frontend clients must NOT directly query database storage

rules.name: Require Service to Repository
rules.description: Service implementations MUST maintain a persistence relationship
